simple.summary: חֲכִילָה (Chăkîylâh) means Chakilah , a hill in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Sam 23 19.

definitions.full: H2444. Chakilah חֲכִילָה proper name, of a location always with article ( dark ) a hill in southern Judah, on edge of wilderness of Ziph 1Sam 23:19 ; 26:1 , 3 (Glaser Skizze ii, 326 reads also for חוילה , q. v., in 15:7 ); ᵐ5 Εχελα 26:1 B Χελμαθ , A Αχιλα .
